title: circle-back hook freezes the session for the whole delay (blocking sleep in Stop hook)
description: Stop hooks run synchronously - Claude Code waits for them. circle-back.sh calls 'sleep $DELAY' inline, so the session is frozen and unusable for the entire delay. Observed: /circle-back 1800 locked a session at 'running stop hooks 2/4' for 7+ minutes before being killed. Live tests 4.1-4.5 all used 3-20s delays, so the freeze was under 20s and read as normal latency - the test plan never exercised a long delay, which is the whole point of the feature. Hook unregistered from settings.json and queues cleared as mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Hook never sleeps; stores absolute due-time and exits 0 silently when not yet due, so the session stays interactive. A long delay is verified to leave the session usable.
close_reason: Hook rewritten to use absolute due times and never sleep. 35/35 offline incl. timing regression guard; direct invocation with a 1800s entry pending returns in 65ms. Awaiting live confirmation that turn-end no longer hangs.

title: circle-back hook fires first-in-file due entry, not oldest-due; docs claim oldest-due-first
description: Live test: entry A queued first with due T+10, entry B queued second with due T+0. At the Stop after T+10 the hook fired A, because it scans file order and takes the first entry whose due <= now. SKILL.md promises 'oldest-due first'. Fix the hook to pick the minimum due among due entries (ties by file order), add an offline regression test, and align SKILL.md/PLAN.md. Also: document CronCreate one-shot as the idle-capable alternative, add argument-hint frontmatter, drop stale 'sleep' reference in PLAN.md 0.3.
close_reason: Hook now fires earliest-due entry (live-verified: D before C); installer backs up only when changing settings; jq-based rollback; docs aligned; CronCreate documented as idle-capable alternative. Offline 45/45.
